description: Compact hover/tap videos with complete original published-figure covers on white.

format.dimensions: Landscape: 720×432 or 768×432; recorded in group manifests.

builder: build_paper_previews.py (base previews; apply ordered current-clip overrides below)
rebuild_order: Run current_clip_rebuild_order sequentially; base builders alone do not reproduce current clips. Source/cache and scratch directories are external command-line arguments. Legacy clip builders also emit obsolete cover drafts; those outputs are not active covers and should not be published.

current_clip_rebuild_order.purpose: Build the base ten previews. Hy-Nomas, IPA, HunyuanVideo and PersonaVlog retain these clips; the remaining clips are replaced by the following steps.
Rebuild the approved Hunyuan-Game poster and clip. This legacy batch also writes an older ResAdapter clip; step 7 must follow.
Replace FaithfulFaces with its continuous official boxing clip.
Replace Reward Lightning with the synchronized four-NFE cherry-street comparison.
Replace Phased One-Step with the continuous official one-NFE snow-forest clip.
Replace Beyond Reward Margin with the published coastal comparison reveal.
Replace the legacy ResAdapter output with the accepted photographic bird comparison. Run after the Game batch.
Export the nine complete original figures used as active covers. Keep the approved Hunyuan-Game poster.
